purpose: Six simplified friendly paper-spirit designs. Reference only; runtime uses hand-authored animated vector parts.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Character exploration sheet for a Chinese cut-paper casual mobile game, exactly SIX friendly little paper spirits in a clear 3 columns x 2 rows grid, each fully visible, equal size, generous white margins. Flat vector-like artwork on warm ivory background, 4-5 solid colors per creature, clean organic silhouette, a single paper fold and at most ONE simple decorative motif per creature. No ornate patterns, no filigree, no scary eyes, no teeth, no fierce brows, no masks, no weapons. Cute expressive tiny black bean eyes with white highlights, peach cheeks, small smile, plump body, short soft appendages, whimsical unique silhouettes readable at 50px. Upper row sea theme: (1) round turquoise puffer-fish with two petal fins and a folded coral-red fan tail, ivory belly, one little wave mark; (2) soft lilac jellyfish like a scalloped mushroom hat with three short ivory ribbon legs and a little gold bell; (3) persimmon coral crab with big rounded mitten claws, tiny teal feet and one ivory shell spot. Lower row celestial theme: (4) chubby sky-blue baby manta ray shaped like a soft four-point star, cream belly, short curly tail and a gold forehead star; (5) small buttery yellow round bell spirit with ivory cloud-shaped hair tuft, little plum tassel and tiny feet; (6) coral and lavender paper swallow kite with rounded wings, tiny cream face and two short ribbon tails. Same elegant paper-cut universe as Chinese landscape backgrounds but simplified, friendly and playful. No labels, no lettering, no UI, no photorealism, no detailed textures, no gradients or 3D.
